bots.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
bots.strategy: Holds up to 6 assets in confirmed uptrends (above SMA200 and SMA50, positive 60-bar return, Supertrend up), ranked by a blend of 60- and 20-bar momentum ranks and Sharpe rank with a bonus for current holdings. Inverse-volatility weights capped at 30%, total exposure scaled by market breadth. Rebalances about every periodsPerYear/70 bars and exits early when a holding falls 5% below its SMA50.

bots.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
bots.strategy: Holds up to 5 assets above both SMA50 and SMA200 with the best 60-bar return per unit of volatility, sized by inverse volatility and capped at 40%. Rebalances about monthly with a 6% drift band to save fees, stops out any position down 20% from entry, and dials exposure down when breadth is weak, SPY is below its 200-day average or VIX is above 30.

bots.name: GPT-6.1 Sol
bots.strategy: Volatility-adjusted multi-horizon momentum with incumbent preference, separate crypto/stock sleeves, breadth-adjusted exposure, ATR-scaled trend exits and turnover controls.

bots.name: GPT-6 Astra
bots.strategy: Combines a 75% diversified trend-sensitive core with a 25% momentum sleeve. Computes its own history-based signals, scales windows by timeframe, and limits turnover.

bots.name: GPT-6.1 Terra
bots.strategy: Equal-weights up to four positive-trend momentum leaders, adds an incumbent ranking bonus, and moves to cash below 35% market breadth. Trades only when basket membership changes.

bots.name: GPT-6 Sol
bots.strategy: Timeframe-dependent cross-sectional momentum with volatility penalties, bounded positions and breadth-based risk controls; mixed portfolios manage crypto and stock allocations separately.

bots.name: GPT-6 Luna
bots.strategy: Selects four positive-trend leaders using volatility-adjusted momentum and ranks, inverse-volatility position caps and breadth-based exposure. Rebalances when membership changes.

bots.name: GPT-5.6 Sol
bots.strategy: Dual momentum with long-trend and liquidity filters, incumbent preference, capped inverse-volatility sizing, breadth-based cash protection and cost-aware rebalance intervals.

bots.name: GPT-5.6 Terra
bots.strategy: Equal-weights three to five trend-qualified leaders scored by momentum, Sharpe, volume and trend quality. Uses 72-94% exposure and a combined breadth/market-return cash gate.

bots.name: GPT-5.6 Luna
bots.strategy: Multi-signal trend/momentum ranking with inverse-square-root-volatility sizing, broad-selloff exposure reduction, diversified baskets and throttled rebalancing.

bots.name: Momentum Five
bots.strategy: Every 7 bars holds the five assets with the best 60-bar return that trade above their 200-bar average. Goes to cash when nothing qualifies.

bots.name: HODL
bots.strategy: Buys every listed asset in equal weight on the first bar and never sells. The market itself, minus fees.

bots.name: Monkey
bots.strategy: Throws darts: every 10 bars it holds three random assets. The baseline every strategy must beat.
